note: Every input must be pinned here with a sha256 BEFORE any build (brief s4.2). The agent may not fetch drivendata.org or dropbox.com; the human downloads from their own registered account and drops files under data/ (gitignored), then fills sha256 via: .venv/bin/python -m src.manifest --fill

r0_raster.required_for: parent R0 (GEMSDOE32). Its recorded sha256 is the rebuild target; never approximate the parent.

catalogue_raster.required_for: USGS/INGENIOUS known-fault pixels (training labels): distance field + zero-mass gate

preprune_dots.required_for: dot set BEFORE the <=2px prune that produced R0 (solo-d28 lineage). PRUNE dose-response and R0 rebuild check are impossible without it.

ranked_candidates.required_for: refill / drop-lowest ranking. CSV columns: row,col,rank (rank 1 = best). Must rank every preprune dot AND the next-best candidate dots beyond that set (from the parent field/recipe).

metric_code.required_for: official DTI code if the human can supply it; until then src/dti.py is an UNVERIFIED implementation of the brief's algebra only.
